## Goal
Fix the frontend/backend seam: request/response DTOs, the shared error format, the receipt lifecycle and the generated OpenAPI spec.

**Depends on:** F01
**Built by:** Plan agent drafts, main session decides

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every endpoint in `contracts/api-endpoints.md` has request and response DTOs in `backend/app/api/schemas.py`
- [ ] The error format is shared by all endpoints
- [ ] `docs/openapi.json` is generated and the drift check passes
- [ ] `contracts/` pages are marked final
